claims.statement: Peripheral insulin sensitivity in skeletal muscle exhibits diurnal variation, reaching peak efficiency during early daylight hours.
claims.notes: Verified against Early Time-Restricted Feeding (eTRF) clinical trials.

claims.statement: Consuming complex carbohydrates earlier in the diurnal cycle aligns with higher insulin sensitivity and enhanced postprandial glucose clearance.
claims.notes: Corroborated by metabolic chamber trials comparing morning vs evening isocaloric carbohydrate loads.

claims.statement: Elevated circulating melatonin during late evening hours suppresses pancreatic beta-cell insulin secretion via MTNR1B receptor signaling.
claims.notes: Late nocturnal eating coinciding with endogenous melatonin onset induces acute glucose intolerance.

claims.statement: Dietary fermentable soluble fibers undergo colonic bacterial fermentation into short-chain fatty acids that support epithelial mucosal barrier function.
claims.notes: Butyrate, propionate, and acetate act as histone deacetylase inhibitors and metabolic signaling ligands.

claims.reason: Violates ASCI Code and FSSAI advertising regulations regarding absolute curative disease claims.

claims.statement: Superfoods can completely cure or reverse malignant cancer.
claims.reason: Deceptive health claim prohibited under statutory drug and medical advertising laws.
